config.neo4j.cypher.topic.dbserver.public.stude: WITH __value.payload.op AS op, __value.payload.after AS after, __value.payload.before AS before FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN op IN ['c','u','r'] THEN [1] ELSE [] END | MERGE (g:StudentGroup {id: after.id}) SET g = after ) WITH op, before MATCH (g:StudentGroup {id: before.id}) WHERE op = 'd' DETACH DELETE g
config.neo4j.cypher.topic.dbserver.public.lectu: WITH __value.payload.op AS op, __value.payload.after AS after, __value.payload.before AS before FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN op IN ['c','u','r'] THEN [1] ELSE [] END | MERGE (l:Lecture {id: after.id}) SET l = after ) WITH op, before MATCH (l:Lecture {id: before.id}) WHERE op = 'd' DETACH DELETE l
config.neo4j.cypher.topic.dbserver.public.stude: WITH __value.payload.op AS op, __value.payload.after AS after, __value.payload.before AS before FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN op IN ['c','u','r'] THEN [1] ELSE [] END | MERGE (s:Student {id: after.id}) SET s = after MERGE (g:StudentGroup {id: after.group_id}) MERGE (g)-[:HAS_STUDENT]->(s) ) WITH op, after, before OPTIONAL MATCH (old_group:StudentGroup)-[old_rel:HAS_STUDENT]->(s:Student {id: after.id}) WHERE op = 'u' AND old_group.id <> after.group_id DELETE old_rel WITH op, before MATCH (s:Student {id: before.id}) WHERE op = 'd' DETACH DELETE s
config.neo4j.cypher.topic.dbserver.public.sched: WITH __value.payload.op AS op, __value.payload.after AS after, __value.payload.before AS before FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN op IN ['c','u','r'] THEN [1] ELSE [] END | MERGE (sch:Schedule {id: after.id}) SET sch = after MERGE (l:Lecture {id: after.lecture_id}) MERGE (g:StudentGroup {id: after.group_id}) MERGE (sch)-[:PART_OF]->(l) MERGE (g)-[:HAS_SCHEDULE]->(sch) ) WITH op, after, before OPTIONAL MATCH (sch:Schedule {id: after.id})-[old_lecture_rel:PART_OF]->(old_l:Lecture) WHERE op = 'u' AND old_l.id <> after.lecture_id DELETE old_lecture_rel WITH op, after, before OPTIONAL MATCH (sch:Schedule {id: after.id})<-[old_group_rel:HAS_SCHEDULE]-(old_g:StudentGroup) WHERE op = 'u' AND old_g.id <> after.group_id DELETE old_group_rel WITH op, before MATCH (sch:Schedule {id: before.id}) WHERE op = 'd' DETACH DELETE sch
